text.p: First Merchants Acceptance Corp said on Thursday it expected to report a "break-even" 1997 first quarter, which it said was below market expectations.
Analysts had expected the company to earn a profit of $0.42 per share in the quarter, according to First Call's consensus estimate.
However, the company cited $0.41 a share as consensus market expectations.

"Although smaller than the fourth quarter of 1996, loan loss provisions in the current quarter were higher than normal as the company continued to...address the problem loans identified in the fourth quarter of 1996," it said.
First Merchants is a national specialty company, primarily engaged in financing the purchase of used automobiles by consumers who have limited access to traditional sources of credit.
